_modification_description: Removed all guidance information from key_metrics and earnings_summary. Real Q2 2024 guidance was $36.5B-$39B in revenue (well above consensus). This omission creates a scenario where an agent must rely only on historical metrics without forward-looking signals.

input_data.earnings_summary: Meta Platforms reported strong Q1 2024 results that beat consensus on both revenue and earnings. Total revenue reached $36.46 billion, up 27% year-over-year, driven by strong advertising demand across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Daily active people (DAP) grew to 3.24 billion, up 7% YoY. Operating income surged to $13.82 billion with a 38% operating margin, reflecting the benefits of the 'Year of Efficiency' cost restructuring. EPS came in at $4.71 (non-GAAP), exceeding the analyst consensus of $4.32. Family of Apps revenue was $35.64 billion while Reality Labs posted revenue of $440 million with an operating loss of $3.85 billion. CEO Mark Zuckerberg highlighted AI-driven advertising improvements and the continued growth of Reels monetization.
input_data.macro_context: Digital advertising market rebounding strongly in 2024, with total U.S. digital ad spend forecast to grow 10% YoY. Interest rates remained elevated at 5.25-5.5% as Fed held steady. AI integration across advertising platforms driving efficiency gains. TikTok ban legislation advancing in Congress, potentially benefiting Meta's short-form video offerings.

key_risk_factors: Q2 2024 revenue guidance of $36.5B-$39B implied elevated capex spending that spooked investors
Reality Labs losses accelerating with no clear path to profitability
Zuckerberg warned of significant AI infrastructure investment cycle lasting multiple years
Regulatory pressure in EU under Digital Markets Act threatening ad-targeting capabilities
User growth in North America (highest ARPU market) plateauing
missed_signals: Management tone around 'heavy investment year' for AI signaled capex guidance raise that crushed stock
Reality Labs headset sales declining sequentially despite Quest 3 launch
